title: Hosea 2
paragraphs: ¹ Say to your brothers, "My People," and to your sisters, "Loved One." ² Confront your mother, confront her — for she is no longer my wife, and I am no longer her husband. Let her remove the marks of her prostitution from her face and the signs of her adultery from between her breasts, ³ or I will strip her naked and expose her as on the day she was born. I will make her like a desert, turn her into dry land, and let her die of thirst. ⁴ I will have no pity on her children, because they are the children of a prostitute. ⁵ Their mother has behaved shamefully. The woman who conceived them has acted disgracefully. She said, "I will chase after my lovers, who give me food and water, wool and linen, olive oil and wine."

⁶ So I will block her path with thornbushes and build a wall against her so she cannot find her way. ⁷ She will chase her lovers but not catch them; she will search for them but not find them. Then she will say, "I will go back to my first husband — I was better off then than now." ⁸ She does not recognize that I was the one who gave her grain, new wine, and olive oil, the silver and gold she lavished on Baal. ⁹ Therefore I will take back my grain when it ripens and my new wine when it is ready. I will take away my wool and my linen that were meant to cover her nakedness. ¹⁰ Now I will expose her lewdness before the eyes of her lovers; no one will rescue her from my hand.

¹¹ I will put an end to all her celebrations — her annual feasts, her new moon festivals, her Sabbath days, all her appointed festivals. ¹² I will ruin her vines and fig trees, which she said were her wages from her lovers. I will turn them into a thicket, and the wild animals will feed on them. ¹³ I will punish her for the days she burned incense to the Baals. She adorned herself with rings and jewelry and went after her lovers, but she forgot me, declares the LORD. ¹⁴ Therefore I am now going to lure her out into the wilderness and speak tenderly to her. ¹⁵ There I will give her back her vineyards, and will make the Valley of Achor a door of hope. There she will respond as in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of Egypt.

¹⁶ In that day, declares the LORD, you will call me "My Husband"; you will no longer call me "My Master." ¹⁷ I will remove the names of the Baals from her lips; no longer will their names be invoked. ¹⁸ In that day I will make a covenant for them with the wild animals, the birds in the sky, and the creatures that move along the ground. Bow and sword and battle I will abolish from the land, so that all may lie down in safety. ¹⁹ I will betroth you to me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in love and compassion. ²⁰ I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will acknowledge the LORD.

²¹ In that day I will respond, declares the LORD — I will respond to the skies, and they will respond to the earth; ²² and the earth will respond to the grain, the new wine, and the olive oil, and they will respond to Jezreel. ²³ I will plant her for myself in the land; I will show my love to the one I called "Not Loved." I will say to those called "Not My People," "You are my people"; and they will say, "You are my God."
